pub fn float_mul() {
    let mut criterion = Criterion::default().configure_from_args();

    mul_f32(&mut criterion);
    mul_f64(&mut criterion);

    #[cfg(f128_enabled)]
    {
        mul_f128(&mut criterion);
    }
}
